notes.title: 🚀 Desktop Fidget - Official Release! 🚀
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]
 We’re excited to share that [b]Desktop Fidget is officially out now on Steam![/b] 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]It’s a cozy little app where you can click, drag, spin, and toss around quirky virtual fidgets - a playful way to keep your hands busy and melt away stress during work or study breaks.[/p][p]The full release includes 20+ fidgets and many hidden things for you to explore.[/p][p]👉 Get Desktop Fidget on Steam: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759380/Desktop_Fidget/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks so much for supporting us and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 💙[/p]

notes.title: Desktop Fidget Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re happy to share that the demo for Desktop Fidget is now live on Steam! 🎉

This cozy little mini-app was born during the development of Lakeside Bar, and quickly became our favorite way to de-stress between tasks.

If you ever feel overwhelmed or just need something to keep your hands busy while working or studying, give it a try!
Click, drag, toss, or simply vibe with sample fidgets in the demo.

👉 Play the Demo on Steam

Thanks for checking it out, and let us know what you think! 💬
Bitcover Team
